mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebay_product_cache (model_no, title, brand, description, product_type, gender, color, colorway, upper_material, image_urls, source, source_updated_at) VALUES (#{modelNo}, #{title}, #{brand}, #{description}, #{productType}, #{gender}, #{color}, #{colorway}, #{upperMaterial}, #{imageUrls}, #{source}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), brand = VALUES(brand), description = VALUES(description), product_type = VALUES(product_type), gender = VALUES(gender), color = VALUES(color), colorway = VALUES(colorway), upper_material = VALUES(upper_material), image_urls = VALUES(image_urls), source = VALUES(source), source_updated_at = VALUES(source_updated_at)
